articlesBefore.title: Meeting Follow-up
articlesBefore.body:
We look forward to meeting you.

The attached document summarizes the project timeline and the next steps.

Please let us know if you have any questions before Friday.

analysis.chinese_translation:
我們期待與你見面。

附件文件總結了項目時間表和下一步。

如有任何問題，請在星期五前告訴我們。
